rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Members assembled at 11:06 with Chief Justice P N Langa in the Chair to elect the President. K P Motlanthe (nominated by B Turok, seconded by B M Ntuli) and W J Seremane (nominated by the Leader of the Opposition) were nominated and a secret ballot followed. After business resumed at 14:03 the Chief Justice announced Motlanthe 269 and Seremane 50, and declared Kgalema Petrus Motlanthe duly elected President.

locator.heading: ELECTION OF PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC OF SOUTH AFRICA; VOTING; (Announcement)

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The Speaker said the swearing-in of the President at Tuynhuys would be televised in the Chamber, and business was suspended from 14:56 to 17:02. Before the recess Motlanthe spoke as "The PRESIDENT-ELECT OF THE REPUBLIC"; after it he gave a statement recorded under "The PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC".

locator.heading: HOURS OF SITTING OF HOUSE; STATEMENT BY PRESIDENT OF THE REPUBLIC IN TERMS OF RULE 106

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: In his statement after 17:02 Motlanthe thanks 'the outgoing President, Mr Thabo Mbeki'. Earlier in the sitting, before the swearing-in, the Speaker refers to 'the previous President', Prince M G Buthelezi honours 'the former President, His Excellency Thabo Mbeki' as he and his wife 'leave office', and Mr W J Seremane tells Motlanthe that he 'will shortly swear an oath'.
